title: Choose a tenancy boundary that matches the consequence
description: Change the workload, sharing boundary, tenant density, and burst overlap. The model exposes isolation gaps, noisy-neighbor pressure, blast radius, accelerator packing, and an illustrative cost envelope together.

workloads.label: Internal experimentation
workloads.detail: Trusted employees run interruptible training and notebook jobs on non-production data.

workloads.label: Customer-facing GenAI
workloads.detail: Independent product teams serve prompts and retrieved enterprise context under latency SLOs.

workloads.label: Regulated decision support
workloads.detail: A high-consequence workflow processes restricted data and needs separately auditable production change control.

isolationPatterns.label: Namespace in a shared cluster
isolationPatterns.detail: Lowest control-plane overhead and strongest packing; every required policy must be configured around the namespace.
isolationPatterns.boundary: shared control plane and shared workers

isolationPatterns.label: Virtual control plane
isolationPatterns.detail: Separates tenant API resources while retaining shared worker pools and some shared failure modes.
isolationPatterns.boundary: separate control plane with shared workers

isolationPatterns.label: Dedicated production cluster
isolationPatterns.detail: Strongest tenant and upgrade boundary, with lower accelerator sharing and higher operational cost.
